interpretation: Historical source-grounded reconstruction, not ex-ante acceptance or a causal experiment.
goal: Verify Pydantic AI inference, safeoutputs MCP availability and an actual read_file read of root README.md; persist the prescribed report and conditional PR outputs.

primary.opportunity: An original smoke-pydantic Pydantic AI engine service lifetime with the source-prescribed README capability test.
primary.acceptance: A protected native invocation/result pair proves read_file returned the first line of root README.md, matching the immutable checkout bytes at the actual run revision. A quote, arithmetic answer, issue, green job, declaration or shell read alone is insufficient.
primary.formula: Count distinct runId/attempt service lifetimes with an accepted root README file-tool read, once per lifetime.

facets.inference: Native provider request/response evidence bound to the Pydantic engine proves the prescribed 2+2 answer; an issue claim alone is insufficient.
facets.mcpAvailability: Protected native tool enumeration or a successful safeoutputs MCP invocation proves actual availability; configuration alone is insufficient.
facets.transport: Independent native protocol or transport receipt, bound to the invocation, proves the transport actually used; source configuration is not execution proof.
facets.safeOutputPersistence: A protected safe-output consumer receipt binds the run/attempt and emitted create_issue payload to the actual persistent issue identity. Agent output or editable footer alone is not persistence proof.
facets.fullGoal: All three source-prescribed tests plus persisted required issue; for pull_request events also the prescribed comment and success-only label. Exact source/import/compiled applicability and all required receipts must be established.
facets.contribution: Protected original producer execution identity binds an accepted native effect to smoke-pydantic. Corroborated editable issue links remain discovery only.
facets.costs: Only matching actual workflow-version/run/period costs, separately reported; no invented credits, dollars, time saved or cost per unknown outcome.

evidencePolicy.sourceApplicability: Inspect and pin coherent source/import/compiled profiles before native-result inspection. Older incompatible profiles stay unknown, not retrospectively failed. Introduction and applicability are separate.
evidencePolicy.discovery: Use production readOutputHistory over every partition, follow forward and reverse relatedCandidates to closure, retain absent references. Discovery is not outcome evidence.
evidencePolicy.scope: At most two initial native run attempts; a partial population remains partial. No borrowed engine-conformance or other workflow cases.
evidencePolicy.deduplication: Deduplicate the same case within runId/attempt service lifetime before assigning the native effect timestamp to an interval.
evidencePolicy.clock: Native invocation and completion ordering must be valid and not after observedAt or the frozen cutoff. Interval starts inclusive and ends exclusive.
evidencePolicy.periods: Seven-day duration and cadence, zero maturation; cutoff-aligned disjoint periods. Missing periods null, not zero; known per-case nonattainment is not complete-population zero.
evidencePolicy.missing: Preserve proven narrow native subtotals through missing other facets or incomplete population coverage. Missing intrinsic read evidence remains null.
evidencePolicy.adoption: Prove actual initial source/compiled addition against its real parent. Missing objects do not prove exhaustion or absence. Do not fabricate a temporal anchor to satisfy the evaluator.
evidencePolicy.decision: Not rated: no source-defined native keep bar, complete-history requirement or causal attribution rule has been supplied.
